summary: Phase 38 — multi-tenant naming/branding for Claros Platform. Backend pytest suite 16/16 PASS covering GET /tenants/me/config (VCE legacy names + ISB canonical), canonical URL aliases for insights/research/learn/people/safe/green (200 + identical bodies vs legacy), config mutation (PUT rename, 30-char validation, NEVER_DISABLE on claros-ai, non-admin 403), branding PUT/reset, and the /canonical/modules catalogue (12 entries). Frontend smoke tested as VCE student (manikanta) — sidebar shows VEDA/ILLUMINATE/PRISM/FACULTY+/ALUMNI360/GUARDIAN/GREENIQ; page-eyebrow on /research/learn/people/alumni-network/safe/green all resolve to tenant names. /insights eyebrow as VCE admin = COMMAND. Admin gate: VCE student redirected from /admin/tenant-config (no admin UI). Admin /tenant-config renders with 12 tenant-module-row-claros-* + branding inputs prefilled (VCE Intelligent Campus / #1565c0); branding save, module rename, per-module reset, and reset-all all work end-to-end.

minor.issue: Per-module reset removes the override row but does NOT re-apply the seed-time VCE display_name. Spec line: 'claros-ai/reset → claros-ai reverts to VEDA (the original VCE seed)' — actual behaviour: reverts to canonical 'Claros AI'. Either (a) re-seed VCE row inside the endpoint, or (b) update spec wording. Full-tenant reset has the same characteristic (canonical, not seed) which the spec explicitly accepts for that endpoint.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate sidebar entries for tenant-branded modules: BOTH the canonical entry (e.g. sidebar-nav-learn → 'ILLUMINATE') AND a separate legacy entry (sidebar-nav-illuminate → 'ILLUMINATE · Legacy') appear. Same for research/prism, people/faculty-plus, alumni-network/alumni, safe/guardian, green/greeniq, insights/command, comply/compliance, enroll/admissions. Either drop the *-Legacy duplicates or visually group them under one collapsible header.
ui_bugs.selector: sidebar-nav-illuminate, sidebar-nav-prism, sidebar-nav-faculty-plus, sidebar-nav-guardian, sidebar-nav-greeniq, sidebar-nav-command

ui_bugs.issue: Top-left tenant chip still hard-codes 'VCE / POWERED BY CLAROS' (institution short_name) instead of reading branding.platform_display_name from TenantConfig. Compare with admin /tenant-config which correctly shows 'VCE Intelligent Campus'.
Renders 'Command · COMMAND' (canonical short + tenant name concatenated). For other tenant-branded modules only the tenant name is shown — inconsistent.

issues: After branding save, top-left tenant chip is NOT updated live (still shows 'VCE / POWERED BY CLAROS') — would need TenantConfigContext refetch on branding mutation. Page eyebrow does refresh on next navigation.

action_items: Decide on per-module reset behaviour: re-apply VCE seed name OR document that reset always goes to canonical.
Remove duplicate '<NAME> · Legacy' sidebar entries (or hide them when the same canonical module is already shown).
Make sidebar tenant header read TenantConfigContext.platform_display_name instead of institution short_name.
Fix the inconsistent 'Command · COMMAND' label on sidebar-nav-command (use tenant display_name only).
Have TenantConfigProvider re-fetch on branding PUT so the live UI (tenant chip, --tenant-primary) updates without a hard refresh.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_tenant_config.update_module: enables setting display_name='' nominally rejected by `1 <= len`, but Pydantic accepts empty string — good. However short_name length=10 may be too loose for sidebar density; consider 8.

canonical_url_rewrite middleware mutates request.scope path BEFORE auth/cors middleware ordering — verified working but means logs will show the rewritten /api/v1/insights path, hiding the actual canonical URL hit. Consider logging both.

seed_tenant_config uses $setOnInsert only: after POST /tenants/me/config/reset (admin), the VCE display names are GONE forever until backend restart. Per-module reset has the same property. Recommend a 'restore_to_seed' helper for admin-driven recovery.

TenantConfigContext (frontend) does not appear to re-fetch after PUT mutations — UI relies on the response body of the mutation only, which works for the admin page but does NOT propagate to the Sidebar tenant chip or other consumers.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all data-testids resolve, eyebrows correct, admin gate works; only cosmetic duplicates/branding-chip-stale)

seed_data_creation: Tests mutate tenant_module_configs/tenant_branding for the VCE tenant. Both pytest fixtures and a final cleanup script restore the original seed (VEDA/ARISE/NEXUS/ILLUMINATE/PATHFINDER/PRISM/COMPASS/GUARDIAN/ALUMNI360/GREENIQ/FACULTY+/COMMAND + platform_display_name='VCE Intelligent Campus', primary_color='#1565C0'). Verified post-test that VCE config is restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_phase38_tenant_config.py (~80s). The login fixture for the student account is flaky (occasional 502 'preview environment not responding') — re-run failing tests once before flagging. Front-end uses [data-testid='page-eyebrow'] on Shell-rendered pages and [data-testid='tenant-config-admin'] + 'tenant-module-row-{id}' / 'module-{displayname|shortname|enabled|reset|save}-{id}' / 'branding-{platform-name|primary-color|save-btn}' / 'tenant-reset-all-btn' on /admin/tenant-config. Sidebar entries use 'sidebar-nav-{key}'. The TenantConfigProvider applies CSS var --tenant-primary on document.documentElement.style — can be inspected via getComputedStyle.
rca_of_the_issue: Per-module reset returns canonical instead of seed name: routes_tenant_config.reset_module simply does db.tenant_module_configs.delete_one({tenant_id, module_id}). After deletion, get_tenant_config falls back to CANONICAL_MODULES (Claros AI), since the seed only runs on server startup with $setOnInsert. Fix: in reset_module, after delete, look up the VCE_NAMES (or generalised tenant-seed) and re-insert if applicable; OR document that the only way back to VEDA after a reset is a manual PUT or backend restart.
